title: View directory tree filtered by file pattern
summary: Display only files that match a specific pattern (like *.txt) and hide directories that do not contain any matching files.

steps.explain: Run `tree` with `-P` followed by a glob pattern (e.g., *.txt) and `--prune` to remove empty branches.

placeholders.name: PATTERN
placeholders.description: A glob pattern to match files, e.g., *.txt or *.jpg.

steps.expect: A tree showing only files matching the pattern and the directories containing them.
